schema.title: Response List Models Api V1 Models Get

post.description:
Recompute every model's latency and reliability from past executions.

The engine does this per workflow for the models it used; this recomputes
the whole catalog, which is what you want after importing history or
changing the window constants. Models with no executions keep their seeded
priors and are omitted from the response.

patch.description:
Amend a task's instructions before it runs.

Only a task that has not started can be edited; rewriting the brief of a
task already in flight would make its output untraceable to any instruction.

post.description:
Put a finished task back in the queue.

The next run of its workflow picks it up; dependants re-run against the
new output because they only advance once their dependencies complete.
